caption: The drawing is of a decorative plate with a circular shape and ornate detailing. The main color scheme appears to be in shades of brown and beige. The outer rim of the plate features a repeating floral motif with leaves and large, detailed flowers at four evenly spaced points. Between these floral designs are rectangular vignettes showing canal scenes, one of which contains a canal boat. These canal scenes are framed by scrollwork. Inside the border is a wreath of small leaves encircling the flat center of the plate. The centerpiece contains an inscription in capital letters, set out in multiple centered lines, which reads: "THE GRAND ERIE CANAL. A SPLENDID MONUMENT OF THE ENTERPRISE & RESOURCES OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK. INDEBTED FOR ITS EARLY COMMENCEMENT & RAPID COMPLETION TO THE ACTIVE ENERGIES, PREEMINENT TALENTS & ENLIGHTENED POLICY OF DE WITT CLINTON, GOVERNOR OF THE STATE." The inner edge of the plate is highlighted with a lighter floral garland, and the plate is photographed against a plain, light background.
title: Memorial Plate - "Dewitt Clinton"
